chart.advanced-settings.note: ledger row: chart.advanced-settings — KNOWN GAP: contextual tab. .ribbon-tab[data-tab=chart-design] ships hidden and is revealed only by clicking img.vector-object[data-kind=chart] inside #editor (editor.js chart click handler); no pre in the runner vocabulary builds chart selection. Probed: playwright click on the hidden tab times out; even with the tab force-shown, chartSettings without a chart only setStatus("No chart selected") + wo:chart-settings marker — openVectorEditor(#chart-dialog) is gated on selectedChart(). needs chart-selection pre

chartupdatedata.note: ledger row: chart.update-data — KNOWN GAP: contextual tab + gated handler. updateSelectedChartData() re-renders the selected chart in place (rerenderChart, no dialog) but returns early with status when no chart is selected (editor.js:13728). Probed: the dropdown does open its ul.menu-list when the page is shown, but the tab itself is unreachable without clicking a chart, and chartType items without a chart only setStatus("Not available yet: chartType bar") — needs chart-selection pre
